description: This file contains the implementation of a ChatController class responsible for managing chat sessions, messages, and related events in an Android application. It handles message sending, session management, event processing from a gateway, and synchronization of chat state, including support for chat history and session selection.

classes.name: MainSessionState
classes.description: A data class representing the state of the main session, including current and applied session keys.

classes.name: ChatHistory
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the chat history details such as session ID, messages, and thinking level.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: A data class representing individual chat messages with role, content parts, timestamp, and ID.

classes.name: ChatMessageContent
classes.description: A data class representing the content part of a chat message, including type, text, MIME type, filename, and base64-encoded content.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: A data class representing a session entry with session key, last updated timestamp, and display name.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolCall
classes.description: A data class tracking pending tool calls in the chat, including call ID, tool name, args, start time, and error state.

methods.name: onDisconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup and state reset when the websocket or session disconnects.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a specific chat session by key and initiates bootstrap process.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key, applies changes, and refreshes chat state accordingly.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a full bootstrap refresh of the chat state and history.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the list of chat sessions from the server.

methods.name: setThinkingLevel
methods.description: Updates the current thinking level setting, normalizing input.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches to a different chat session by key and reloads chat history.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with optional attachments and thinking level, asynchronously.

methods.name: sendMessageAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for server acknowledgment, returning success status.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts all pending chat runs.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes real-time events from the gateway, updating chat state accordingly.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes chat state, subscribes to events, fetches history and sessions, checks health.

methods.name: fetchSessions
methods.description: Requests session list from the server.

methods.name: pollHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Periodically checks the gateway health status.

methods.name: handleChatEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming chat events, including message delta updates and session resets.

methods.name: handleAgentEvent
methods.description: Processes agent-specific events such as assistant streaming or tool calls.

methods.name: parseAssistantDeltaText
methods.description: Extracts streaming text update from assistant delta payload.

methods.name: publishPendingToolCalls
methods.description: Updates the observable list of current pending tool calls.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for a pending run and cancels it if it exceeds the threshold.

methods.name: clearPendingRun
methods.description: Removes a specific run ID from pending list and cancels its timeout.

methods.name: clearPendingRuns
methods.description: Clears all pending runs and associated timeouts.

methods.name: parseHistory
methods.description: Parses chat history JSON into structured chat messages and session info.

methods.name: parseMessageContent
methods.description: Parses individual message content items from JSON array.

methods.name: parseSessions
methods.description: Extracts session list from JSON response.

methods.name: parseRunId
methods.description: Extracts run ID from a server response JSON.

methods.name: normalizeThinking
methods.description: Normalizes input string for thinking level.
